title: Mafia
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael becomes convinced that Grotti, an insurance salesman, is a mobster trying to intimidate him. Despite receiving threatening messages and suspicious behavior, it is eventually revealed that Grotti is merely a pushy salesman. Michael, with the support of Dwight and Andy, confronts Grotti publicly and humorously navigates the situation, ultimately standing down the supposed mafia threat. Meanwhile, other office subplots include Kevin dealing with credit card fraud concerns and Pam managing frustrations over a cancelled credit card while on the phone.

main_threads.thread: The revelation that Grotti is not mafia but a pushy insurance salesman, and Michael's reaction to this truth.
